title: Surface active Tdarr Matrix progress on Home
summary: Home automatic refresh now includes the lightweight Tdarr Matrix status read so active matrix runs can surface without opening Diagnostics Advanced.
reason: The backend already reports active Tdarr Matrix retry/full runs, but the WebView automatic refresh skipped the Tdarr route unless Diagnostics Advanced was active, leaving the Home matrix card stale.
behavior_before: Automatic refresh did not request /api/diagnostics/tdarr-matrix/latest from Home, so the Home matrix card could remain at Checking/No data during a live run.
behavior_after: Automatic refresh requests /api/diagnostics/tdarr-matrix/latest?finding_limit=0 while Home is visible and renders the existing backend-owned active-run payload.
tests_added: Extended tests/webview/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py coverage for Home Tdarr Matrix automatic refresh.
manual_validation: Direct tdarr_matrix_console_payload check returned run-20260612-200034-retry369 as processing with worker_result_count 77 of 369.
rollback_plan: Revert the shouldRefreshTdarrMatrix Home branch and the matching WebView boundary test assertion.
